documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Intimation Under Regulation 8(2) Of SEBI (Prohibition Of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
Corporate Action - Fixation Of Record Date For Interim Dividend

analysis.summary: R R Kabel Limited delivered its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax in Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching INR 3,168 crores, up 54% year-on-year. Wires & Cables volume grew by 17% year-on-year, led by over 25% growth in cables and 12% in wires. The FMEG segment achieved operational breakeven during the quarter with a revenue growth of 28% year-on-year. Management maintained its volume growth outlook of around 18% for the year and reaffirmed its overall margin guidance of 10.5% by FY28. R R Kabel reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue for Q1 FY27, growing 54% YoY to INR 31,682 Mn, driven by healthy domestic demand and export growth.

guidance.claim: R R Kabel continues to maintain its overall Wires & Cables margin guidance of 10.5% by FY28.
guidance.quote: we continue to maintain our overall margin guidance of 10.5% by FY '28.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve around 18% volume growth in the current year.
guidance.quote: So this year also, we are expecting around 18% volume growth.

guidance.claim: Management targets improving margins by 100 basis points on a year-on-year basis.
guidance.quote: So if you see our overall guidance, like we had targeted to improve our margins by 100 basis points on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting top-line growth of around 20% in the FMEG business while making it profitable on a sustainable basis over the next 2 to 3 years.
guidance.quote: So first of all, we are targeting growth of around 20% in FMEG business and also achieving breakeven on sustainable basis for this year and then make this business profitable in coming 2, 3 years on continuous and sustainable basis with top line growth of around 20% year-on-year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve breakeven in the FMEG segment in FY27.
guidance.quote: Importantly, FMEG losses have reduced as compared to last year, and we remain on track to achieve breakeven in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management targets a volume growth of 16% to 18% on a yearly basis in the Wires & Cables segment.
guidance.quote: On a yearly basis, whatever the prediction we have given on like our yearly basis, volume growth will be like, always remain better than industry growth and whatever we have projected in our slides in the range of 16% to 18%.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve 10.5% EBIT margins in the wire and cable segment by FY28.
guidance.quote: Even going forward, we are like quite positive to achieve our target of 10.5% EBIT margins in wire and cable segment by FY28.

guidance.claim: For the FMEG business, management targets a value growth of around 20% to 25% in FY27.
guidance.quote: It seems, in this year, if everything remains same then, we are targeting value growth of around 20%-25% in FMEG business.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall Wires & Cable volumes grew by 17% year-on-year with balanced growth in domestic and export markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, Wires & Cable volumes grew by 17% year-on-year with similar growth seen both in domestic and export markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Cables volume grew faster than wires, registering over 25% growth compared to approximately 12% growth in wires.
demand_outlook.quote: Cables grew significantly faster with more than 25% volume growth, while volume growth in wires was approximately 12%.

demand_outlook.claim: FMEG revenue grew by approximately 28% year-on-year supported by premium and new product launches.
demand_outlook.quote: FMEG revenue grew by approximately 28% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management estimates that 2% to 3% of the market shifts from unorganized to organized players annually.
demand_outlook.quote: So I think the journey is almost same and similar, so maybe 2% to 3% yearly the market is shifting from unorganized to organized.

demand_outlook.claim: R R Kabel reported 54% YoY revenue growth in Q1 FY27, driven by healthy domestic demand and export growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Delivered highest-ever quarterly revenue, growing 54% YoY, led by healthy domestic demand and export growth

demand_outlook.claim: Wires & Cables segment revenue grew 57% YoY on impressive volume growth, strong execution, and favorable industry dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: Continues to outperform by delivering growth of 57% YoY on the back of impressive volume growth, strong execution and favorable industry dynamics

demand_outlook.claim: FMEG revenue growth was supported by demand for premium and new products across key categories and distribution expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong growth in revenue, supported by continued demand for premium and new products across key categories and ongoing distribution expansion

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remained healthy while export demand was relatively stronger during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remained healthy while export demand was relatively stronger during the quarter, benefiting from our established global presence, our quality, and diversified market reach.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry demand remains supportive while export markets continued to perform well.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry demand remains supportive while export market continued to perform well.

demand_outlook.claim: In the FMEG segment, market conditions remained competitive while demand trends continued to be selective.
demand_outlook.quote: In the FMEG segment, market conditions remained competitive, while demand trend continues to be selective.

capex_expansion.claim: New capacity additions at Silvassa are expected to be commissioned during the current quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity expansion program is also progressing as planned with new capacities expected to be added during the current quarter in Silvassa.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add capacities at Waghodia focused on the cable segment during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: But at the same time, in this year, we'll add a few capacities at Waghodia also, which will be highly focused on cable side of the business.

capex_expansion.claim: R R Kabel has an overall capex plan of around INR 1,200 crores with almost 80% dedicated to cables.
capex_expansion.quote: If you see overall, we had a capex plan of around in 1,200 crores, in which almost 80% is focused towards cable side of business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to deploy INR 600 crores to INR 650 crores in capex during the current fiscal year.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of which, like last year, we did around INR300 crores, and this year, major of that expansion will be executed and as of INR600 crores to INR650 crores will be deployed in this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The INR 1,200 crore capex program for FY26 to FY28 is progressing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: Our INR1,200 crores capex program for FY26 to FY28 is progressing as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex program is primarily focused on expanding cable capacity along with wire capacity and improving operating efficiencies.
capex_expansion.quote: The program is primarily focused on expanding cable capacity along with wire capacity and improving operating efficiencies.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has invested almost INR 300 crores out of the INR 1,200 crore capex plan in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: What we have planned, like investment of INR1,200 crore, out of which, almost INR300 crores we have invested in FY26 already.

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA margin expanded to 9% in Q1 FY27 compared to 7% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The operating EBITDA margin improved to 9% compared to 7% in Q1 FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: Wires & Cables segment profit margin increased to 9.9% from 7.6% in the corresponding quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: The segment profit margin improved to 9.9% compared with 7.6% in the corresponding quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: FMEG reached operational breakeven in Q1 FY27 compared to an operating loss of INR 7 crores in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The segment reached an operational breakeven position compared with a loss of approximately INR7 crores in Q1 FY '26 and a loss of approximately INR9 crores in Q4 FY '26, making a significant milestone in the FMEG business transformation, driven by premium products and operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly results included an exceptional gain of approximately INR 14 crores due to labor code provision reversals.
margins_costs.quote: The quarter also included an exceptional item of approximately INR14 crores relating to reversal of the provision for the statutory impact of the new labor codes.

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA increased 99% YoY with EBITDA margin expanding by 205 bps YoY, driven by business mix, margin expansion, cost discipline, and execution efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: Operating EBITDA increased 99% YoY, with EBITDA margin expanding by 205 bps YoY, driven by improved business mix, margin expansion, cost disciplined and execution efficiencies

margins_costs.claim: PAT surged 129% YoY with PAT margin improving by 212 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT surged 129% YoY, with PAT margin improving by 212 bps YoY, reflecting sustained profitability improvement

margins_costs.claim: Wires & Cables segment margin expanded by 232 bps YoY due to product mix, disciplined commodity management, and operating efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: Segment margin expanded by 232 bps YoY, reflecting improved product mix, disciplined commodity management and operating efficiencies

margins_costs.claim: FMEG segment achieved operational breakeven in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Achieved operational breakeven, marking a significant milestone in the FMEG business transformation

margins_costs.claim: FMEG segment profitability improved substantially YoY driven by premium products and operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: Segment profitability improved substantially on a YoY basis, driven by premium products and operating leverage

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improved on the back of operating leverage and disciplined cost management despite raw material volatility.
margins_costs.quote: Profitability improved on the back of operating leverage and disciplined cost management despite raw material volatility and global turmoil.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices, particularly copper, aluminium, and PVC, remained volatile during the period.
margins_costs.quote: At the same time, raw material prices, particularly copper, aluminium, and PVC remained volatile during the period, while currency movement and freight cost added pressure across the value chain.

margins_costs.claim: Segment profit for the Wires and Cable segment was supported by scale benefits, effective management of price volatility, and operational efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: For FY26, segment profit stood at INR775.6 crores compared to INR496.5 crores in FY25, up 56.2% year-on-year, supported by scale benefits, effective management of price volatility, and operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for wires is currently around 65% to 70%.
With the new capex plan, the company will achieve the capability to build up to 220 KV cables.
orders_capacity.quote: With new capex plan, we'll be able to achieve capability to build up to 220 KV, which is like lower end of EHV or higher end of HV side of the cable with this capex plan of INR1,200 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital days remained broadly stable at 50 days during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital days remained broadly stable at 50 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved a dividend of INR 5.50 per share, taking the total dividend to INR 9.50 per share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: it pleases me to announce that the Board of Directors of the Company has approved a dividend of INR5.50 per share, taking the total dividend to INR9.50 per share for FY '26.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted ongoing volatility in metal prices and foreign exchange along with global market uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter continued to see volatility in metal prices and foreign exchange, along with uncertainty across global markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disruptions in Middle East exports during early Q1 were partially offset by growth in other export markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: The disruption in the Middle East was partially offset by other export markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain challenges continue to persist for the business.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, supply chain-related issues still remain, but we are confident of overcoming those challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter was marked by heightened geopolitical tension, creating uncertainty in global trade conditions and volatility in input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter was marked by heightened geopolitical tension, which created some uncertainty in global trade conditions and volatility in input costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export growth faced disruptions due to conflict and issues in the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: While domestic business has shown healthy growth, export growth also remained encouraging despite the disruption in the Middle East.
